name: Witch Hunter · Knight style B (Inquisitor)
description: Mercy Crane as a grim inquisitor in the plumed Knight’s style: a tall-crowned slate hat with a crimson band and a silver buckle, its brim dipping over her eyes, a dark slate long coat whose split tails stream behind her like the Knight’s cape, and a crimson scarf whose long ends fly back from the nape like his plume (crimson is the one strong accent). Brown hair tied back, a small grim face in profile, a leather baldric with silver buckles, tall black boots. She carries a heavy ornate silver crossbow at the hip (a three-pixel recurved silver prod, a silver-railed walnut stock with inlay and a crimson stone). As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted. Her idle breathes while the scarf and coat tails ripple; on the walk they stream back. Attack: she swings the crossbow up, shoulders it and leans in, the bolt head glints, then the bolt leaves on attack index 3 as a bright silver streak with a white flash off the snapping prod while the recoil kicks the nose up and the scarf is flung back; the streak breaks up and she lowers the crossbow to span it again. The silver bolt head glows at night.
